__inputs.name: DS_INFLUXDB
__inputs.label: InfluxDB
__inputs.description: InfluxDB data source for F1 telemetry

description: F1 25 Live Telemetry Dashboard with Track Map, Speed, Braking, and Tyre Data

panels.title: 🏎️ LIVE TRACK MAP
panels.description: Official track layout with live car positions. Color = braking intensity.

targets.query: from(bucket: "f1_telemetry") |> range(start: 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z, stop: 2000-01-02T00:00:00Z) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "track_layout") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> sort(columns: ["seq"])

from(bucket: "f1_telemetry") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "track_map" and r.driver == "Player") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "f1_telemetry") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "track_map" and r.driver == "Rival") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "f1_telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "car_telemetry" and r._field == "speed_kph") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean)

from(bucket: "f1_telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "car_telemetry" and (r._field == "brake" or r._field == "throttle")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean)

from(bucket: "f1_telemetry") |> range(start: -1m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "tyre_wear" and r.driver == "Player") |> last() |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

from(bucket: "f1_telemetry") |> range(start: -1m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "tyre_damage" and r.driver == "Player") |> last() |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

from(bucket: "f1_telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "tyre_wear" and r.driver == "Player") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean)

title: F1 25 — Live Telemetry + Track Map
